shared_elements: procession of standing human figures in profile
register bands of relief separated by horizontal moldings
figures facing in a consistent direction, one behind the other
hands touching or holding the figure in front
low relief carving on a wall frieze
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: horizontal registers of processing robed figures in profile, one behind another with hands touching the person ahead, wearing tall headgear, and including a figure leading a quadruped, all rendered in shallow relief with the same proportions and drapery conventions. The main difference in content is that A is a close view showing an ornamental rosette border above and below, while B shows multiple stacked registers including a tree and additional animals, but this looks like different parts of the same iconographic programme.
